🚨 NHS analysis puts the cost of industrial action in 2025/26 at an estimated 171,776 appointments and procedures.

The list has fallen from its peak, and that deserves saying. It still stands at 7.27m cases, with about 106,000 waiting over a year.

The median wait is 11.9 weeks, against 7.5 before the pandemic.
